title: Battle of Halidzor
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Halidzor", at revision 1373076404, opens: "The Battle of Halidzor took place in the spring of 1727 at Halidzor Fortress, in what is now the Syunik region of Armenia, near the modern-day city of Kapan, between the Armenian forces under the leadership of David Bek and the Ottoman army." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q13053399, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1727 battle in Syunik". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
